title: Afternoon finance/legal scrapbook - quick todos

---
Invoice checks (quick table in head)
1) INV-2026-1197 — Acme Health — $18,450.00 — due 2026-02-28 — status: unpaid, AP contact: lisa@acmehealth.com (left VM 03/09). Next: escalate to AM (Priya) if no reply by 03/15.
2) INV-2026-1214 — BrightRetail — $4,120.50 — due 2026-03-05 — partial payment received $1,000 — dispute on tax line. Ticket: JIRA-FIN-2042. Need credit note or explanation; follow-up w/ Billing Ops (Samir).
3) INV-2026-1228 — Nova Labs — $2,250.00 — due 2026-03-11 — autopay failed. Retry scheduled 03/13; if fails, put hold on new Dedicated capacity until cleared.
4) Small/low risk: INV-2026-1239 (<$500) — set to auto-chase next Friday.
Notes: prioritize >$5k & >30d. Use standard template email (Confluence: invoice-runbook).

---
Contract redlines (notes-to-self)
- Acme Health MSA (v3-draft) — main convo points:
  * Data residency clause: ask Legal to add explicit EU processing carveout (customer asked for FRA region).
  * Indemnity cap: propose changing from 3x fees to 1x fees or fixed $250k cap — discussion needed w/ legal.
  * Service credits: narrow measurement window from 24h to 12h for latency SLO — product OK but Legal concerned about exposure.
  * IP clause: remove blanket assignment language — replace with license back to customer for customer data only.
Action: attach inline comments in Google doc, leave 2 unresolved cl. Then ping @Priya for commercial tradeoffs.

- Redwood Partner Addendum (draft) — small changes: add reporting cadence (monthly), tighten termination notice from 60 -> 30 days.

---
Renewal reminders / watchlist
- BrightRetail — renewal 2026-04-02 — likely to expand embeddings usage; prep proposal for dedicated capacity pricing (estimate uplift +15%).
- Nova Labs pilot — renewal 2026-03-30 — remind Customer Success to run usage summary and health check; include any regressed evals.
- Small customers (<$10k) consolidated review 2026-03-25: batch renewals for auto-send.
